error.title: Deadline Web Service Connection
error.description:
## Could not connect to Deadline Web Service
The publish process cannot reach the Deadline Web Service. This is required for farm rendering.
### How to repair?
1. **Check if Deadline is running**: Make sure the Deadline Web Service is running on the configured machine. 2. **Verify the URL**: Confirm the Deadline Web Service URL is correct in your Settings. 3. **Network connectivity**: Ensure you have network access to the Deadline server. 4. **Contact your admin**: If the issue persists, contact your pipeline admin.
error.detail:
### __Detailed Info__
The Deadline Web Service must be running and accessible for farm rendering to work. Common causes: - Deadline service is stopped or crashed - Network connectivity issues - Incorrect URL configuration - Firewall blocking the connection - Wrong hostname or port number

error.title: Deadline Web Service Timeout
error.description:
## Connection to Deadline Web Service timed out
The Deadline Web Service is not responding within the expected time. This usually means the service is overloaded or unreachable.
### How to repair?
1. **Wait and retry**: The service may be temporarily overloaded. Wait a moment and try publishing again. 2. **Check Deadline status**: Ask your admin to check if the Deadline server is under heavy load. 3. **Check network**: Verify your network connection is stable and not experiencing issues. 4. **Contact your admin**: If timeouts continue, contact your pipeline admin.
error.detail:
### __Detailed Info__
Connection timeouts can occur when: - Deadline server is under heavy load with many job submissions - Network latency is high - Firewall is rate-limiting connections - The Deadline service is becoming unresponsive

error.title: Deadline Web Service Not Configured
error.description:
## Deadline Web Service URL not configured
No Deadline Web Service URL has been configured in your settings.
### How to repair?
Contact your pipeline admin to configure the Deadline Web Service URL in the OpenPype Settings.
error.detail:
### __Detailed Info__
The Deadline Web Service URL must be configured before you can use farm rendering. Your admin should set this in: Settings > Modules > Deadline > deadline_webservice_url
